<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_AnnualAudit" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/annual-audit">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_AnnualAudit" name="Annual Audit Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_AuditTeams">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditCoordinator" name="Audit Coordinator">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_AuditInitiated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegionalOffice" name="Regional Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Prep_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareStatements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Prep_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ComplianceTeam" name="Compliance Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegulatory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CentralAuditTeam" name="Central Audit Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Discrepancy_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Discrepancy_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskParallel_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinancialRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OperationalRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ComplianceRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskParallel_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HighRisk_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Investigation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditDirector" name="Audit Director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" name="Audit process initiated">
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send audit notification to regional office"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Split" name="Start preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareStatements" name="Prepare financial statements and gather documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegulatory" name="Check regulatory updates affecting audit"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Join" name="Preparation completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents to central audit team"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Discrepancy_Merge" name="Review entry" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewSubmission" name="Review submission"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" name="Discrepancies found?" default="Flow_NoDiscrepancies"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestClarifications" name="Request clarifications from regional office"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideClarifications" name="Provide necessary clarifications"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskParallel_Split" name="Start risk assessment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinancialRisk" name="Evaluate financial risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OperationalRisk" name="Evaluate operational risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ComplianceRisk" name="Evaluate compliance risks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskParallel_Join" name="Risk assessment completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" name="High risk identified?" default="Flow_NoHighRisk"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Investigation" name="Conduct detailed investigation">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Investigation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DataAnalysis" name="Perform data analysis"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_Interviews" name="Conduct interviews"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" name="Site visit required?" default="Flow_Inv_NoSiteVisit"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SiteVisit" name="Conduct site visit"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge" name="Investigation activities done"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Investigation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Investigation" targetRef="Task_DataAnalysis"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_2" sourceRef="Task_DataAnalysis" targetRef="Task_Interviews"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_3" sourceRef="Task_Interviews" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_SiteVisit" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" targetRef="Task_SiteVisit">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${siteVisitRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_NoSiteVisit" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_4" sourceRef="Task_SiteVisit" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_5" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_Investigation"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RiskMerge" name="All risks addressed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompileReport" name="Compile audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportMerge" name="Report submitted for review"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewReport" name="Review audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval_Split" name="Report approved?" default="Flow_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateReport" name="Update report with required revisions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeReport" name="Distribute final report to executive board"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveReport" name="Archive final report"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AuditClosed" name="Audit process closed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareStatements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_PrepareStatements" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatory" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Join" targetRef="Task_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ReviewSubmission" targetRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Discrepancies" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" targetRef="Task_RequestClarifications">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${discrepanciesFound == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_RequestClarifications" targetRef="Task_ProvideClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarifications" targetRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDiscrepancies" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" targetRef="Gateway_RiskParallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskParallel_Split" targetRef="Task_FinancialRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskParallel_Split" targetRef="Task_OperationalRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskParallel_Split" targetRef="Task_ComplianceRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_FinancialRisk" targetRef="Gateway_RiskParallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_OperationalRisk" targetRef="Gateway_RiskParallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ComplianceRisk" targetRef="Gateway_RiskParallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskParallel_Join" targetRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HighRisk" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" targetRef="SubProcess_Investigation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${highRiskIdentified == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoHighRisk" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" targetRef="Gateway_RiskMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="SubProcess_Investigation" targetRef="Gateway_RiskMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskMerge" targetRef="Task_CompileReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_CompileReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_ReviewReport" targetRef="Gateway_Approval_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Revisions" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_UpdateReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${revisionsRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_DistributeReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_UpdateReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_DistributeReport" targetRef="Task_ArchiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveReport" targetRef="EndEvent_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
